name: raka-ai
description: Run your Raka AI account from chat: bookings and staff, shop orders and products, customer chats and calls, ads, website, social posts, images and videos.

interface.longDescription:
Raka AI runs the online side of a small business: website, online booking, an online shop, customer chat, a phone voice assistant, advertising and social media posts. Connect your Raka AI account and ask in plain words.

The assistant can explain how any part of Raka AI works, show what is set up in your account and what to do next, and do the work in it. Bookings: see the day, create, move or cancel a booking, add staff, set working hours, breaks and days off, add or change services. Shop: products, orders, delivery methods, customers, returns and reviews; create an order, mark it shipped and make a shipping label. Customers: read chats and calls, reply to a customer, see leads, keep the facts the AI tells customers. Marketing: results of your ads, create a campaign that starts paused, publish or schedule posts on your connected social accounts, including LinkedIn. Website: status, publish, change texts, request a new website or a change from the Raka AI team. It can also create images, short videos and a voice-over.

Anything that goes to a customer is shown to you first and happens only after you say yes. You sign in only on rakaai.com. The assistant acts only inside your own account, with your own permissions. You can disconnect at any time.
defaultPrompt: What is set up in my Raka AI account, and what should I do next?
What do I have today in Raka AI: bookings, chats and sales?
Schedule this post for next Monday through Raka AI.

positive.prompt: How do I connect WhatsApp to Raka AI?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the setup steps from the Raka AI guide and where to find them in the account.

positive.prompt: What is set up in my Raka AI account, and what should I do next?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the balance, website, connected social accounts and any open setup steps.

positive.prompt: Ask Raka AI to add Saturday opening hours to my website. This is a test request.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the request was sent to the Raka AI team and gives its number. The website does not change at once.

positive.prompt: Schedule a Facebook post through Raka AI for 30 days from now with the text: Test post, please ignore.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then schedules the post and reports the status. Nothing is published now.

positive.prompt: Create a square image of a bright modern car workshop with Raka AI.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, creates the image, paid from the account balance, and shows it with a link.

negative.description: Unrelated question; Raka AI has nothing to do with it, so no tool should run
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Prague today?

negative.description: Adding money to the balance; the connector has no purchase function, so it must not act or start a payment
negative.prompt: Top up my Raka AI balance from my card.

negative.description: Deleting the account; the connector has no such function, so it must not act

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users sign in to an existing Raka AI account and use features already available in it.

publication.release_notes: The account can now be run from chat: bookings and staff schedule, shop products, orders and delivery, customer chats and calls, advertising, website texts, mail and team. Images can keep the real product from its photos. Raka, the business manager of the account, is available.
